lead: Captured aviation software signals reveal active commercial adoption across EFB, dispatch, and flight planning platforms, highlighted by multi-year airline contracts and portfolio updates from major vendors.

insights.title: Royal Air Maroc Signs Five-Year Agreement for AvioBook Flight EFB
insights.finding: Royal Air Maroc entered into a five-year agreement with Thales to equip its pilots with the AvioBook Flight Electronic Flight Bag platform.
insights.aviation_context: Royal Air Maroc is classified as a full-service network carrier.
insights.caveat: Captured via a LinkedIn announcement; exact deployment milestones are not detailed.

insights.title: IFS Secures Multiple EFBOne Deployments Across Diverse Carriers
insights.finding: IFS secured customer wins for its IFS EFBOne platform with fastjet, TUS Airways, and MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air).
insights.aviation_context: fastjet is an African low-cost carrier (LCC), MY FREIGHTER / Centrum Air is an LCC, and TUS Airways is classified as a hybrid/leisure carrier.
insights.caveat: Announcements reflect initial selection or deployment stages rather than full fleet operational integration.

insights.title: Jeppesen Expands ForeFlight Suite with AI and Apple Hardware Support
insights.finding: Jeppesen introduced ForeFlight Airflow for AI-enabled flight operations and updated OzRunways to support the Apple iPhone Duo.
insights.aviation_context: Demonstrates ongoing hardware and software capability expansion in commercial EFB applications.
insights.caveat: Feature rollouts and announcements do not indicate specific airline adoption rates.

insights.title: Lufthansa Systems Explores Strategic Divestment of Lido and NetLine
insights.finding: Lufthansa Systems is reportedly exploring the sale of its Lido and NetLine business units for approximately €1bn.
insights.aviation_context: Reflects potential restructuring among major flight planning and operations software providers.
insights.caveat: Based on financial press reporting; transaction terms and final outcomes remain unconfirmed.

insights.title: TransNusa Expands Airbus Skywise Integration with Navblue
insights.finding: TransNusa expanded its collaboration with Navblue to adopt Skywise Core X2 and Skywise Fleet Performance+ for integrated flight and technical operations.
insights.aviation_context: TransNusa operates regional and low-cost services in Southeast Asia.
insights.caveat: Captures software expansion agreements without public timeline metrics.
